summary: Periodic SIEM export with entity reconciliation mapping and legal snapshot attestation for EU payments audit
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a recurring SIEM export that includes per-event entity reconciliation metadata (mapping internal tenant/user IDs to customer-supplied pseudonyms), a GPG-signed snapshot manifest for each daily export, and a short attestation statement for legal review.

Impact: Nordica Payments requires this data package to satisfy an EU regulatory audit window. Failure to provide a deterministically comparable snapshotable export will delay their certification and could impact production go-live timelines.

Environment: Production (eu-west-1), tenant-scoped exports for multiple subaccounts under Nordica Payments AB.

Steps to reproduce / current approach:
1) Customer has configured a tenant-specific webhook to receive audit events (webhook-based delivery).
2) They asked for a dry-run: export of a 24-hour window (2026-03-01 00:00:00 -> 2026-03-02 00:00:00) as NDJSON with an additional reconciliation.csv that maps event.entity_id -> pseudonym_id.
3) They expect a manifest.json.gpg containing SHA256 checksums for each file, and a signature using our GPG key for non-repudiation.

Expected behavior: A reproducible export containing: archived ndjson (events), reconciliation CSV, checksum manifest, GPG signature, and a one-paragraph attestation stating export time range, export generation method, and operator who triggered it.

Actual behavior observed: Support previously generated ad-hoc exports but without reconciliation mapping in the customer-specified format and without a signed manifest. Customer also wants per-event monotonic sequence numbers preserved across retries to enable deterministic replay.

Logs / attachments: customer-provided mapping schema (reconciliation_schema_v2.csv), sample webhook delivery logs (redacted), and their legal checklist (Nordica_Audit_Checklist.pdf). Attached by customer in ticket thread.

Request: Please provide a plan and ETA for: (A) producing the requested dry-run export (single 24-hr window) with reconciliation CSV and GPG-signed manifest; (B) adding a recurring scheduled export option (daily rolls, 30-day retention bundle) that preserves per-event sequence numbers and includes per-file checksums; and (C) documenting the attestation wording we will produce for legal teams.
